subject: SilverlinePay: Security milestone & SOC 2 package — MAP draft and dates
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@silverlinepay.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@silverlinepay.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: SilverlinePay: Security milestone & SOC 2 package — MAP draft and dates

Hi Alex + Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, attached is a first-pass MAP draft focused on the security/SOC 2 milestone so we have clear owners and dates aligned to your procurement timeline. High-level items and proposed dates below (open to adjustments):

1) Redwood provides SOC 2 questionnaire template — deliver by 2027-04-21 (owner: Redwood - Stephanie)
2) Silverline completes questionnaire (security POC) — due 2027-04-27 (owner: Silverline - Priya)
3) Redwood sends evidence checklist + evidence matrix — deliver by 2027-04-22 (owner: Redwood - Neha)
4) Silverline submits evidence artifacts (logs, config docs, vendor attestations) — due 2027-05-06 (owner: Silverline - security POC)
5) SOC 2 review call (we walk the artifacts) — target 2027-05-10 (owner: shared)
6) Redwood finalizes SOC 2 package for your procurement team — deliver by 2027-05-17

Target contract close window reflected in MAP: week of 2027-05-17 (target close: 2027-05-21). Dependencies we flagged on the call: access to snapshot logs (read-only), confirmation of the internal security POC, and any third-party vendor SOC reports (if available).

Attachments: 20270420-SLP-MAP-DRAFT.pdf (MAP draft), Redwood-SOC2-Evidence-Checklist-v1.pdf (checklist stub).

Can you confirm the security POC (name and preferred email) and whether the proposed dates are workable? If procurement needs a later evidence submission window we can adjust — want to lock owners first.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
[Attachment: 20270420-SLP-MAP-DRAFT.pdf (7 pages)]
[Attachment: Redwood-SOC2-Evidence-Checklist-v1.pdf (2 pages)]

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@silverlinepay.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@silverlinepay.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20T16:30:00-04:00
Subject: Re: SilverlinePay: Security milestone & SOC 2 package — MAP draft and dates

Thanks Stephanie — good summary and appreciate the rapid turnaround. Two quick items from our side: 

- Please add our InfoSec lead Markus Lane (markus.lane@silverlinepay.com) on the thread — he'll be the one to own evidence submission.
- We have an internal procurement freeze affecting vendor docs from 2027-04-29 through 2027-05-05. That pushes our realistic evidence submission to the week of May 10–14. Can you slide the evidence deadline to 2027-05-13 and move the review call to 2027-05-18?

Also, would you be able to include a couple of sample evidence snippets (e.g., an example audit log extract and a sample config page) so our InfoSec can confirm format expectations before we compile everything?

Alex Turner
Head of Procurement, SilverlinePay
alex.turner@silverlinepay.com
[Note: please also include Markus Lane on future emails]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-21T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SilverlinePay MAP - proposed timeline adjustments

Stephanie / Sean —

I've reviewed Alex's note and propose we accept the procurement window constraint and re-anchor the MAP accordingly. Suggested adjustments (keeps same order, new dates):

- Redwood questionnaire template -> 2027-04-21 (no change)
- Silverline completes questionnaire -> 2027-04-28 (Priya)
- Redwood finalizes evidence matrix -> 2027-04-26 (Neha)
- Silverline evidence submission -> 2027-05-13 (Markus / Silverline InfoSec)
- SOC 2 review call -> 2027-05-18 (shared)
- Redwood delivers packaged SOC 2 artifacts -> 2027-05-25
- Target contract close -> 2027-05-28

Owner mapping (quick):
- Questionnaire + MAP sign-off: Stephanie (AE) / Priya (Silverline)
- Evidence matrix & sample snippets: Neha (SE) -> I will attach an evidence matrix and two example snippets for Alex's team to review.
- Evidence ingestion & verification: Redwood engineering (Sean) / Silverline InfoSec (Markus)
- Final packaging & legal checklist: Stephanie + Redwood legal ops

Attachment: evidence_matrix_SLP_v1.xlsx (matrix with column owners and examples). I'll prepare the two sample snippets (audit log sample, nginx config excerpt) and drop them in the Drive link.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
[Attachment: evidence_matrix_SLP_v1.xlsx (1 sheet)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@silverlinepay.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@silverlinepay.com>, Markus Lane <markus.lane@silverlinepay.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-21T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SilverlinePay: Security milestone & SOC 2 package — updated MAP and next steps

Alex / Priya / Markus —

Thanks — confirmed we've looped Markus in. Per Neha's proposed schedule above, we've updated the MAP to reflect the procurement constraint and new milestone dates. Next concrete steps:

- Neha to upload example evidence snippets and finalized evidence matrix to the Drive folder today (link below).
- Stephanie to push updated MAP + DocuSign envelope for sign-off by EOD 2027-04-22.
- Silverline to confirm questionnaire owner (Priya) and confirm access method for read-only log snapshot (SFTP link or ephemeral GCS credentials) by 2027-04-23.

Confirmed dates (please acknowledge if any of these are not workable):
• Questionnaire template from Redwood: 2027-04-21
• Silverline questionnaire complete: 2027-04-28 (Priya)
• Evidence matrix & samples: 2027-04-26 (Neha)
• Evidence submission: 2027-05-13 (Markus / Silverline)
• SOC 2 review call: 2027-05-18
• SOC 2 package delivered: 2027-05-25
• Target contract close: 2027-05-28

Links / attachments: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/987654321 (deal), https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cSLP-SOC2-evidence (Drive). DocuSign envelope will be sent once Priya confirms the questionnaire owner. Attached: Signed-MAP-Silverline-Redwood-20270421.pdf (MAP with responsibilities) and Redwood-OnePager-Security.pdf.

Ask: Please reply with a short ACK and confirm Markus will be the point for evidence submission. If we don't hear back by EOD Friday (2027-04-23) we'll assume dates are accepted and move DocuSign -> MAP sign-off.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
[Attachment: Signed-MAP-Silverline-Redwood-20270421.pdf (2 pages)]
[Attachment: Redwood-OnePager-Security.pdf (1 page)]
